title: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) and the RMF

videos.script: ISO 27001 asks how you manage security. The NIST Cybersecurity Framework asks a simpler question first: what should a security programme achieve? {{question}} Its answer is six functions. Govern, identify, protect, detect, respond and recover. Every lesson of this course fits under one of them. {{functions}} You will see how an organisation uses the framework to describe where it is today and where it wants to be, and how to say how mature its practices are. {{profiles}} Then a second NIST document with a different job. The Risk Management Framework is a step-by-step process for approving one system to run, used across the US government. {{rmf}} Last, how the frameworks fit together, so you can read any of them without starting from zero. {{fit}}
